name: Hannah Scott
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Hannah's marriage to John S. Jones (1834-1904) in 1856 and her death on 17 Feb 1910. It has a child born in Wales in 1861, so the couple apparently spent time in Wales (S1). A Social Security file for her son Frank Sylvester Jones names his mother as Hanna Scott.
